D0.note: Retain A opening cue as delivered in AP2; source opening section annotations and cue references are preserved below. Actual D mix is pending.

D1.note: The Ring motif completes over the old story; ours remains one note short. The new forging front opens from the drawn-ring burn.

D2.note: Climbing Ring motif, beatwise taiko and gap ticks; the Deep tick divides faster. The withheld note sounds once in stopped brass inside the conditional vision.

D3.note: A slowing forge is overtaken and rejoins; the race continues.

D4.note: Two horns, left and right, at the crowns and two fires; nearer answers. Adapt to the explicit holdout insert and map holds. Low D watch tone begins.

D5.note: Working forges continue; real cadence at the abandoned Deep. The great lantern carries the light forward at the speed of the visible path; keep the Ring motif incomplete.

D6.note: The ridge fires keep watch; warm glow breathes once per bar.

D7.note: First full Beacon-theme cadence at dawn; restored terraces and plenty lead into the unfinished written leaf, blank pages and plagal title close. Optional private voice slot unassigned.
